kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أسترجل (form X)
# أَسْتَرْجِلُ (ʔastarjilu) /ʔas.tar.d͡ʒi.lu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِسْتَرْجَلَ (istarjala)
# أَسْتَرْجِلَ (ʔastarjila) /ʔas.tar.d͡ʒi.la/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَرْجَلَ (istarjala)
# أَسْتَرْجِلْ (ʔastarjil) /ʔas.tar.d͡ʒil/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِسْتَرْجَلَ (istarjala)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
